title: Pilot Listening Evaluation
intro: Listen carefully to each sound and record the first clear issue you notice, if any.
internal_testing_notice: Internal development study only. Do not recruit external participants until the supervisor and ethics process permits it.
instructions: Use headphones in a quiet environment if available.
Play every sample at least once before answering.
Report the first obvious technical problem you hear, then rate the overall quality.
Your response is saved after each trial and an interrupted session can be resumed on this browser.

issue_type.label: Does this sample contain an obvious problem?
